notes.title: DEMO UPDATE #1 – Thank You & Fixes!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Thank you so much to everyone who played our demo.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve fixed some bugs and made a few improvements.

[b]Patch Notes - Update #1:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where blink events wouldn't trigger when eyes were nearly closed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the screen to stay black after the intro cutscene if the game lost focus.[/p][/*][*][p]The drawer open sound effect is now properly audible.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced the doctor's voice volume during the tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all the support and feedback![/p][p]If you have any thoughts or run into issues, feel free to [url="https://discord.gg/s2rKGd2a"]join our Discord[/url] and let us know.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Our Demo is now Live!
notes.notes: [p][b]Thank You for Being Here[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to finally share the [b]Veil of Sight demo[/b] with you.[/p][p][/p][p]This has been a deeply personal project for us. A story-driven psychological horror game built around one simple but terrifying mechanic: [b]you choose when to blink[/b] and sometimes, that’s all it takes for the world to change around you.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo is a small slice of what we’re building - around 20 minutes of unsettling exploration, subtle horror and the first hints of a larger mystery. There may be some bugs and things will improve as we head toward release, but we hope it gives you a taste of what’s to come.[/p][p][/p][p]If you play it, we’d love to hear your thoughts. And if you enjoy what we’re trying to do, [b]adding the game to your wishlist[/b] really helps more than you might think.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for checking it out and whatever you do, don’t blink for too long.[/p][p][/p][p]- The Emberfall Games Team[/p][p]👁️[/p]

notes.title: Veil of Sight – Announcement Trailer & Steam Page Now Live!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re thrilled to officially launch the Steam page for [i]Veil of Sight[/i], our upcoming psychological horror game.[/p][p]
In [i]Veil of Sight[/i], you are the subject of a horrific eye experiment. Blinking is no longer automatic, you must [b]hold and release your blink manually[/b]. [/p][p]But every blink is dangerous. [/p][p]Explore a decaying hospital. Survive the experiments. Discover why the doctor chose you.[/p][p][/p][p]Watch the Announcement Trailer[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/9qvI04wu6hM"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Wishlist [i]Veil of Sight[/i] now to support us and get notified when the demo is live![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of our journey.[/p][p]This is just the beginning.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Emberfall Games[/i][/p]
